description: Empirical net-plant-efficiency curve vs resource temperature. eta_net(T) tabulated from eta = eta_utilization * eta_Carnot * (1 - pump_parasitic) at the F1a design rejection temperature. 1-D np.interp lookup.
source: Tester et al. (2006). The Future of Geothermal Energy, MIT/DOE. DiPippo (2015) Ch. 16. Breakpoints reuse EC154 F1a numbers (eta_utilization=0.40, pump_parasitic=0.10, T_reject=30 degC).

T_reject_ref.note: Rejection temperature at which the efficiency curve was tabulated (F1a design)

eta_utilization.note: EGS gross utilization efficiency reused from F1a

pump_parasitic_fraction.note: Circulation-pump parasitic load folded into the net efficiency table

eta_net_rated.note: Net plant efficiency at T_geo=200 degC, T_reject=30 degC, after 10% pump parasitic

curve.note: Net plant efficiency vs resource temperature (degC) at T_reject=30 degC. eta = 0.40*(1-(Trej+273.15)/(Tgeo+273.15))*(1-0.10).
